text:
Five tools are exposed. list_models returns every served model with its tier, its backend
and the result of the last health probe, plus a per-backend status list. get_stats returns
request and token counts per model since the process started, read from the same in-memory
metrics as the HTTP path. route_test_request takes a prompt argument, sends it through
the identical gateway chat path including metrics recording and span emission, and returns
the text, model, reason, and trace id. inspect_trace takes a trace_id and returns every
span of that trace with prompts redacted, or error -32004 when the trace does not exist.
 get_drift_report returns the last two golden eval runs with their delta, alert flag, and
worst cases.

MCP server

The same Go binary runs a second mode as an MCP server over stdio, selected with
the --mcp flag. It speaks JSON-RPC 2.0 with newline-delimited messages and
implements the MCP handshake: initialize , notifications/initialized ,
 tools/list , and tools/call . A malformed line gets JSON-RPC error -32700
instead of being silently dropped.
